facts.text: The hotel is directly at the Brandenburg Gate.
The hotel is on the Unter den Linden boulevard in Berlin's Mitte district.
facts.excerpt: takes up an important position on the Unter den Linden

facts.text: The central elephant fountain was a gift from a visiting Maharajah at the hotel's launch in 1907.
facts.excerpt: a gift from a visiting Maharajah at the launch of the hotel in 1907

facts.text: The current hotel opened under the Kempinski name in 1997 as a symbol of German Reunification.
facts.excerpt: the new Aldon opened as a symbol of German Reunification under the Kempinski name, once again establishing itself immediately as a social hub in 1997.

facts.text: Rooms have windows that open and look out on the Brandenburg Gate.
facts.excerpt: The light-filled rooms and windows that you can open look out on the Brandenburg Gate.

facts.text: Breakfast is served at the BeL Etage.
Brasserie Quarre has outdoor tables and serves bistro dishes such as bouillabaisse.
facts.excerpt: Brasserie Quarré meanwhile has tables outside and bistro favourites such as bouillabaisse or a Berlin Special; veal liver.

facts.text: The hotel serves currywurst Adlon-style with gold leaf.
facts.excerpt: Another Adlon classic is the Berliners favourite street food, Currywurst, served Adlon-style with gold leaf.

facts.text: The spa has a Finnish sauna, a hammam, ice baths and an ice waterfall.
facts.excerpt: the Finnish sauna and hamman, the ice baths, and the ice waterfall

facts.text: The spa is a child-free zone for guests under 16.
facts.excerpt: the Spa is a child-free zone for those under 16.

facts.text: Guests can take an Adlon Bike to the Tiergarten park.
facts.excerpt: the vast state park, the Tiergarten, to which you can take your Adlon Bike for an adventure

facts.text: The hotel has original Art Deco elevator clocks that show which floor you are on, an antique from the original building.
facts.excerpt: Look out for the original Art Deco elevator clocks, which tell you which floor you are on; an antique from the original building.

facts.text: Children receive age-appropriate gifts in the bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: From age-appropriate gifts in the bedrooms

facts.text: The hotel has ground-floor suites and wheelchair access points with adaptable bed levels.
facts.excerpt: There are ground-floor suites and access points destined for those in wheelchairs with adaptable bed levels.
